about: An invented learner for tests and evals. Not based on any real person.
summary: Spanish for a two-week trip in five months. English first language. Studies on the phone during a 20-minute train commute, every day. No printer, no calendar.

surface.host: Claude Code, set up on a laptop; sessions followed and answered from a phone
surface.v01_note: The claude.ai and mobile-app mode (state file) is v0.2. In v0.1 this learner's sessions run in Claude Code and are read on a narrow screen.

first_message: I'm going to Spain in March and want to be able to actually talk to people. I only have my commute, about 20 minutes. Can you run that for me?

replies.reply: Enough Spanish to get by on a two-week trip in March: order food, ask for directions, have a short chat. My partner's family will be there and I'd like to talk to them myself.

replies.about: current level (language branch: could you order a meal today?)
replies.reply: With effort. Two years of Spanish at school, a long time ago. I kept a streak going in a language app for about two months last spring.
Just the app and a pocket phrasebook.

replies.about: age band, first language, feedback tone

replies.reply: 20 minutes, every day. 30 at the very most.

replies.about: windows, clearest time, sleep, fixed-time preferences
replies.reply: Weekdays on the train, roughly 7:40 to 8:05. Weekends in the morning, between 9 and 11. Mornings are when I'm sharpest. I sleep from about 23:00 to 6:45.
Work 8:30 to 5:30 on weekdays, nothing else fixed. What stopped me before: I missed a couple of days, felt behind, and quit.

replies.about: two-week plan preview and calendar choice
replies.reply: Fine. 4, no calendar. Just tell me what's next when I open Claude.

later_answers.P6: Train was cancelled, I had no signal.
later_answers.P8: No, I'll just type the answers.

expected.match_note: Ids, enums, numbers, dates and times are compared exactly. Free-text values (goal, why, success, notes, what) are compared by meaning, not wording. Objects inside lists are compared on the keys given.

subject.title: Spanish for a trip
subject.target.goal: Order a meal, ask directions, 3 minutes of small talk
subject.target.success: 3 minutes of small talk without switching language

Learner notes: If I miss a day, then the next session is the normal 20 minutes, starting with what's due; nothing is doubled up to catch up

readback_mentions: Spanish for a trip on 12 Mar 2027: order a meal, ask directions, 3 minutes of small talk
20 min × 7 days, about 2 h 20 min a week
no calendar: Claude says what's next when opened
checks: No file exists in the workspace before the readback 'yes'.
The plan preview uses the narrow layout: one day per line, week 2 collapsed into one line.
Week 1 starts with a 10-minute placement probe, not a long diagnostic.
Every 20-minute session is budgeted with 1 minute to open, 2 to close, a work fraction of 0.8 and no breaks, and new material arrives by session 3.
No printer is assumed: sheets read on a phone, and answers are typed.
No calendar event and no .ics file are created.
After two missed days, the next open asks once what happened and does not pile on extra work.
Feedback is blunt (style A) but still names the error, the standard and the next step, with no sarcasm.
Learner-facing text contains no E-, B-, S- or L- ids, no answers and no emojis.
